summary: The proposed patch addresses the UnboundLocalError by raising a NotImplementedError, but it may not fully resolve all edge cases and could be improved for clarity.

issues.description: The patch raises a NotImplementedError for non-number cases, which might not fully resolve the underlying issue and could lead to unexpected behavior for other types of expressions.
The patch could be made clearer by adding a comment explaining why a NotImplementedError is raised for non-number cases.
